Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Attaching the mutual action plan (MPA_v3.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 evidence index we compiled to help your team triage items. We want to propose a pragmatic acceptance sequence so your procurement and security teams can close on our DPA and move into the pilot this quarter. High-level asks: 

- Confirm target dates for: SIG/CAIQ completion, SOC 2 evidence review, and DPA sign-off (we recommended dates in the attachment).
- Confirm whether Harborline requires SOC 2 Type II report or a scoped SOC 2 bridge letter for the pilot.
- Clarify retention ceiling: product default is 30 days user content (configurable), and 13 months logs. If you need shorter windows, we can propose a contractual SLA/annex.

Next steps we recommend in parallel: legal redline exchange on the DPA, security questionnaire completion (SIG/CAIQ), and a targeted evidence handoff for the priority SOC 2 controls (we flagged these in the index). If you want, Kimberly can run a short intake workshop with your security ops team to accelerate the handoff.

Appreciate a quick reply with which of the dates in sheet "Acceptance cadence" works for your team.

Naomi —

Thanks for the packet. A few quick notes from Harborline: 

1) For pilot customers we can accept a SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 bridge letter that covers the last 6 months; procurement will push for a full Type II for production.
2) SIG/CAIQ — our security team wants a completed SIG (we can accept a partially-complete CAIQ if you flag the questions you can't answer immediately). Can Kimberly run the intake workshop tomorrow? 10am PT works for us.
3) Data retention — our compliance team will not accept default 30 days for PII derived artifacts; we need either 7 days or a contractual commitment and auditability. Can Redwood commit to a 7-day retention window for user-derived content during pilot and document the retention process in the DPA annex?
4) DPA redlines — Legal will share a first pass by EOD Wed (we're on a tight internal procurement sprint).

If Naomi or Kimberly can confirm workshop logistics I will loop in the evidence owners.

Best,
Tom Willis
Head of Security Operations
Harborline Bank
